E2967

Frame resource schedule refused: {detail}

What

Frame resource schedule refused: {detail}

Why

The scheduler derives dependencies, transfers, lifetimes, and reuse only from checked access and completion facts; an unresolved alias or completion would make execution unsafe.

Fix

Move the call out of the frame callback, or give the operation a complete checked access contract and its real completion event.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2967: tests/ui/frame_schedule_core_primitive_without_completion.stderr.
